chosen_private_structure.summary: A single complete module with literal retained output data, two cohesive backward-scan helpers, and seven exported behavior functions.
chosen_private_structure.countTodoDistances: Owns assistant-turn accumulation and two independently discovered distances, allowing shouldBuildTodoReminder to express the conjunction.
chosen_private_structure.findModeReminder: Owns the most recent runtime-mode marker and real-user-turn distance; the public builder owns admission and native total-marker reduction.
chosen_private_structure.prose: A cooked multiline template holds workflow interpolation; full/sparse/exit arrays hold existing output expression and LF joins.
chosen_private_structure.metadata: Direct switch dispatch returns each collaborator factory result unchanged.
chosen_private_structure.authorship_claim: Cohesive private decomposition was freely chosen from the behavior contract. Retained expression and ordinary idioms are required expression; this record makes no naming-only novelty or license grant claim.

retained_expression.classification: Existing schemas/protocol/types/fields/prose/formats/constants/evaluation and ordinary idioms, with no new grant or novelty claim.
retained_expression.workflow: head and ordered span text retained as exact cooked template text; Explore and tool-name imports interpolate dynamically; planResearchAgentCount interpolates the required constant 3 twice.
retained_expression.full_sparse_exit_todo: Exact retained lead/array strings, punctuation, LF breaks, Unicode em dash and blank segments preserved.
retained_expression.joins: Output builders use LF joins with no added final newline; source has one final LF.
retained_expression.todo_format: Native map and LF join preserve holes; unmodified status/content interpolation and canonical header.
retained_expression.output_style: Exact name format; trimmed prompt gates admission only and is neither emitted nor logged.

public_surface.imports: All four import statements retained exactly from imports.json; no additional imports or reexports.
public_surface.qualified_parameter: planEnabled: boolean = mode === "plan" retains the inherited optional boolean public parameter/default while supplying the explicit TS9011 annotation.

behavior_preservation.factory_identity: Returned factory object is unchanged; no alias conversion or admission.
behavior_preservation.todo_scan: Backward live index reads; metadata marker detection precedes both-found break and attachment classification; assistant tool-call match captures distance before increment; post-increment both-found break retained; absent distances fall back to total assistant count.
behavior_preservation.todo_native_semantics: Non-null assertion creates no runtime guard; undefined/hole entry property failures propagate. toolCalls?.some retains native behavior; synthetic assistants count normally, attachment markers are discoverable.
behavior_preservation.todo_gate: Both assistant distances must be >= 10; no human/date counts or persistence.
behavior_preservation.mode_gate: Explicit false returns null before inspecting entries; explicit true enables every mode; omitted parameter defaults to mode === plan.
behavior_preservation.mode_scan: Backward live scan finds marker before attachment classification; only user messages marked real_user increment human turns; found marker with fewer than 5 returns null.
behavior_preservation.mode_cadence: Native reduce counts all runtime_mode metadata markers, including attachments and synthetic entries, plus one; modulo 5 === 1 selects full reminder for 1/6/11, otherwise sparse; reduce skips native holes.
behavior_preservation.style_gate: Optional outputStyle then native prompt.trim evaluated first; property/trim failures propagate; falsey trimmed prompt or absent style returns null; name is interpolated unchanged.
